entry.title: 875 North Michigan Avenue
entry.note: Fresh public OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms the unchanged exact Q217727 outline 31064573 and eight independent roof/facade/penthouse/antenna ways. Native +X is almost east, slightly north; +Z is almost south, slightly east. Penthouse 1282265474 and west/east mast ways 279951771/279951772 fix the signed roof layout. TILT is on the native +Z south facade according to the operator. The original overall map frame is retained; minimum ground Y=0. Published 343.7 m architectural and 456.9 m highest tip supersede conflicting map height tags. Lower east mast 435 m is estimated from current architect photos, not surveyed. Terrain slope and exact door location unmeasured; accepted plan 2 m/1 degree, footprint replacement disabled. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
